thread:
Anya: Draft PRD posted in drive — section 'Launch gates & experiments' needs sign-off. TL;DR: want a lightweight rollout with an experiment to validate latency and cost impact. Can people review acceptance criteria by EOD?
Sam: skimmed — a couple quick q's: what are the exact SLO targets we gate on? p50/p95? token-cost delta?
Anya: Good Q. Proposed gates: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 300ms, token cost delta <= +15% relative to baseline, accuracy/regression score delta <= 1.5% on the eval suite. Those are the hard gates.
Lia: For the eval suite, we should add an adversarial prompt bucket (long context + repeated entities). Past rollouts missed cache-regression cases. I'll add 200 prompts to the PRD.
Kevin: Rollback / pinning notes: rolling deploy with staged pin windows. Canary at 2% for 30m, then 10% for 1h, then 50% for 2h before 100%. Automatic rollback if p95 increases by >25% OR error rate >0.5% OR token-cost hits +30% and stays for 15m. Ops should be able to manually pin traffic to previous model with one command.
Sam: Can we make the canary weight progressive by user cohort rather than strict percentage? e.g., internal beta -> power users -> general? That helps catch regressions tied to specific usage patterns.
Anya: Yes, cohort-first rollouts are preferred. Add a path: internal -> power -> general. Percentage fallback path still listed for emergency.
Sam: For experiment logging, suggest we emit these metrics per route: model_version, seq_len, prompt_bucket, tokens_out, latency_ms_p95, error_flag. Minimal schema: `model_version, cohort, route, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms_p95, errors`
Kevin: Confirm deploy-bot can enforce automatic rollback thresholds. We'll wire these rules into the release job. deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window set to 02:00-06:00 UTC?
deploy-bot: :gear: scheduled rollout job created. Job ID r-2024-1103-7. Will post health checks to #incidents.
Lia: Edge cases: long-token streaming behavior — if streaming stalls we should surface fallback to non-streaming and close the session with a clear user-facing code (RETRY_STREAM). Add that to acceptance criteria.
Anya: Good catch. Also need a canary experiment definition for A/B: variant A=baseline model, variant B=new model with quantization profile. Primary metric = user completion quality score (human eval bucket) + secondary = latency. Experiment length 7 days, min sample per cohort 500 normalized sessions.
Sam: Quick config snippet for experiment flags (yaml):
```
experiment: rollout_v2_quant
variants:
  - id: baseline
    weight: 50
  - id: quant_v2
    weight: 50
cohorts: [internal,power,general]
metrics: [human_eval_score, p95_latency, token_cost_delta]
min_samples: 500
```
Sam: Will add the infra PR for the flag and the metric export in the morning.
Kevin: Ops runbook: 1) monitor deploy-bot channel alerts, 2) if auto-rollback triggers, run `rb model previous` and notify stakeholders, 3) if metric drifts but below auto-rollback, open hotfix branch and pin traffic to previous model. I'll draft the steps.
Anya: Thanks — can we get final sign-off by tomorrow 11:00 PT? If approved we'll schedule the canary next Thu night.
Lia: I'll finish eval additions tonight.
Sam: I'll push infra changes and the experiment flag PR by tomorrow morning.
Kevin: I'll draft runbook and config for automated thresholds.
Anya: Awesome. If nothing else, I'll merge gates into PRD and tag the rollout doc. :thumbsup:
